caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow plate with a detailed decorative design. The plate has a light brown or beige background and a scalloped orange-brown rim. At the center of the plate is a stylized floral motif: a large eight-petal flower with brown and yellow petals occupies the upper central portion, while swirling stems extend outward and downward, ending in multiple smaller bud-like shapes colored in brown and outlined with yellow. The stems are green with yellow accents. The base of the plant appears to emerge from a geometric vessel with a wide body and a narrow base, decorated with triangles and oval shapes filled with brown and green colors. The surrounding interior surface of the plate has green patches and less distinct brown swirls, contributing to a varied background. The overall color palette consists of shades of brown, yellow, green, and orange, with all the elements contained within the circular boundary of the plate, set against a plain, light beige exterior background. There is a small signature in red in the bottom right section outside the plate.
title: Pa. German Pie Dish
